title: 第17章 人族的脊梁第18章 出关下山
slug: 寻仙启示录第204章有区别吗
content_zh:
烛光晃动，惊觉了左丘辰视线，放眼看去外面一片漆黑，不知不觉已然深夜，左丘辰抱起《九州大陆通鉴》就欲回到自己房间。
就在这时，左丘辰心中想起慕容仙儿的话，“此后七日入睡必须进入那个名为斗伐的阵！”
左丘辰不傻，既然她这样告诫自己，那么必有缘由，想到慕容仙儿为自己做的一切，左丘辰心中一暖，然后迅速离去。
这几日慕容仙儿基本在木屋之中，不曾出来，左丘辰知道慕容仙儿所做之事肯定自有原因，故左丘辰也没去打扰，
左丘辰不知道的是，那个在梦中在黑暗中看到无畏一切美到窒息的脸，已经深深印入他的心底...
“吱呀”
木屋的门被打开，一道身影闯入，房内从地面到屋顶被白光笼罩，斗伐阵如同有生命般被激活。
可是此刻少年无比好奇古籍上的后续记载，故此一下窜倒在床上津津有味的看着古籍...
“还算听话，不用多费心。”
朝暮居顶木屋内，少女般模样的慕容仙儿低语，好似觉得左丘辰像个孩子很听话一般。
但是说出此话后，她却陷入了良久的沉默。
想起自己出生的那日，黑暗世界内同样一位被万族瞩目的婴儿诞生，那是一个集万千信仰和希望的存在，从出生到现在，短短十来年突破圣阶，此举不但超过了所有仙古域所有天才，还超过了九天域的天骄。
族内顶着压力，表面的嬉戏，暗地的残酷，让自己在突破圣阶时候隐藏，为了保全全族从而成就了别人的辉煌。
“值得吗？”
慕容仙儿盯着眼前漂浮的精血自语，那个世界的残酷超过了这世间所有的苦难，而为了族人，为了战争自己妥协了。
以圣人之下的境界出现，以玩世不恭，以心高自傲的贵族千金模样，最后在众族的不教不礼，甚至不顾全大局的角度让慕容族，甚至让自己处在一个尴尬的位置。
虽然慕容仙儿知道这个人设能保全族人，但是很多时候那股自信，那傲气，还有那不甘的性格让自己觉得还是很懦弱...
“为何各域勾心斗角，为何不能齐心！”
脸色苍白，眉心点点血迹，眼前的精血漂浮，桌前一颗似钻石般无比精纯的灵石发光，慕容仙儿犹豫了，第一次她自我怀疑，第一次发现自己是带着那不屈的性格逃避了。
“如你独自上左丘山一样，我生来倔强，如你一样，但我希望你不是那个妥协之人！”

桌面极品灵石散发的灵力和魂玉融合，化为一道有型的蓝色能量，最后皆是被那滴血红色鲜血吸收...
对于木屋内发生的事情左丘辰全然不知，以为此刻他依旧沉迷于书海中。
对于黑暗纪元的惨烈，左丘辰很是感慨，虽然事情过去了数万年，但是细想起来，生在那个纪元真的是一种悲哀。
泛黄的古籍翻阅，时光冉冉，古籍记载持续万年的战争最终在两族伤亡殆尽的情况下停止，不是没有继续相互争夺，而是没有资本了。
“万年大战，九州大陆天崩地裂，血流成河，最终两族默契般的停战，如此开启了长达一万多年的盛世之治！”
一笔带过，寥寥几字结束了那个黑暗纪元，一个新的纪元，被世人称作盛世之治，各族修生养息，没有争斗，没有战争，从此九州大陆回归平静。
左丘辰叹气，像是在看一长篇跌宕起伏的小说，最后的大高潮过后，一切回归到了最原始模样。
古籍记载盛世之治时期，人族和魔族甚至互相来往贸易，交易各自灵石符文货币，其余各族之间也是相互来往，关系甚密。
时间就这样安稳惬意的流逝，盛世之治期间所有生灵皆是九州大陆的一员，各个种族枝繁叶茂，好似大世就这样被诸族迎来。
左丘辰翻篇，古籍已然到了最后几页，就在他翻开下一页的时候，少年难掩脸上的震惊，因为余下书页的都是缺角，或是残破的，甚至还有被人撕下的篇章。
“为何会如此？难道后来发生了什么不为人知的事情？”
少年带着好奇神情低语，眼前半篇古籍古老的文字也是浮现在他眼前。
“盛世期间，诸族汇聚天都，最后以人族和魔族为首两大阵营对峙，大战再次爆发并持续千年，九州大陆被撕裂，天都破碎，巨大力量下，天都地面出现裂痕，最后从小变大化为渊。”
“后人称之为天渊！”
从此一个响彻大陆，一个诸族口中的禁忌存在就这样出现了。
content_en:
The flickering candlelight caught Zuo Qiuchen's sight. It was pitch black outside, and it was already late at night before he knew it. Zuo Qiuchen picked up the "Jiuzhou Continent Tongjian" and wanted to return to his room.
At this moment, Zuo Qiuchen thought of Murong Xian'er's words, "You must enter the formation called fighting for the next seven days before you fall asleep!"
Zuo Qiuchen was not stupid. Since she warned him like this, there must be a reason. Thinking of everything Murong Xianer had done for him, Zuo Qiuchen felt warm in his heart and left quickly.
Murong Xian'er has basically been in the wooden house these days and has never come out. Zuo Qiuchen knew that there must be a reason for what Murong Xian'er did, so Zuo Qiuchen didn't bother him.
What Zuo Qiuchen didn't know was that the face that made him suffocate when he saw Wuwei in the dark in his dream had been deeply engraved in his heart...
"Squeak"
The door of the wooden house was opened, and a figure broke in. The room was shrouded in white light from the ground to the roof, and the fighting formation was activated as if it were alive.
But at this moment, the young man was extremely curious about the subsequent records in the ancient books, so he fell on the bed and read the ancient books with relish...
"It's quite obedient, so don't worry too much."
In the wooden house where Chao Mu lived, the girl-like Murong Xian'er whispered, as if she thought Zuo Qiuchen was as obedient as a child.
But after saying this, she fell into silence for a long time.
Thinking back to the day when he was born, a baby was born in the dark world that attracted the attention of all races. It was an existence that gathered countless faiths and hopes. From birth to now, it took just over ten years to break through the holy level. This move not only surpassed all the geniuses in the Ancient Immortal Realm, but also surpassed the geniuses of the Nine Heavens Realm.
Under the pressure within the clan, he was playful on the surface and cruel secretly, allowing himself to hide when he broke through the holy level. In order to protect the whole clan, he achieved the glory of others.
"Is it worth it?"
Murong Xianer stared at the essence and blood floating in front of her eyes and muttered to herself that the cruelty of that world exceeded all the suffering in this world, but she compromised for the sake of her tribe and the war.
Appearing in a realm below a saint, acting cynical and arrogant like a noble daughter, in the end, the Murong clan and even himself were placed in an embarrassing position due to the rudeness and disrespect of other clans, and even the disregard of the overall situation.
Although Murong Xian'er knew that this persona could protect her clan members, her self-confidence, arrogance, and unwillingness often made her feel very cowardly...
"Why are the various regions fighting each other, why can't they work together!"
Her face was pale, her eyebrows were dotted with blood, the essence and blood were floating in front of her eyes, and an extremely pure spiritual stone like a diamond was shining in front of her desk. Murong Xianer hesitated. For the first time, she doubted herself. For the first time, she realized that she had escaped with her unyielding character.
"Just like you going up Zuoqiu Mountain alone, I am born to be stubborn, just like you, but I hope you are not the one to compromise!"
The spiritual power emitted by the top-quality spiritual stone on the table merged with the soul jade, turning into a stylish blue energy, which was finally absorbed by the drop of blood-red blood...
Zuo Qiuchen was completely unaware of what happened in the wooden house, thinking that he was still addicted to the sea of books at this moment.
Regarding the tragedy of the Dark Era, Zuo Qiuchen was very moved. Although tens of thousands of years have passed, when he thinks about it carefully, it is really sad to be born in that era.
As time passes by while flipping through the yellowed ancient books, the ancient books record that the war that lasted for thousands of years finally came to an end when the two tribes suffered all casualties. It was not that they no longer continued to compete with each other, but that they had no capital.
"The war of ten thousand years, the Kyushu continent was torn apart and the earth was torn apart, and blood flowed into rivers. In the end, the two clans reached a tacit agreement to cease the war, thus starting a prosperous era that lasted for more than ten thousand years!"
With one stroke, a few words ended that dark era, and a new era was called the rule of the prosperous age by the world. All races cultivated themselves and rested, there were no fights, and there were no wars. From then on, the Kyushu continent returned to peace.
Zuo Qiuchen sighed, as if he was reading a long novel with ups and downs, and finallyAfter the climax, everything returned to its original state.
Ancient books record that during the prosperous period, the human race and the demon race even traded with each other, trading their respective spiritual stones, runes, and currencies. The other races also had close relationships with each other.
Time passed by peacefully and comfortably. During the period of the prosperous age, all living beings were members of the Kyushu Continent. All races flourished, as if the great age was ushered in by all races.
Zuo Qiuchen turned the page, and the ancient book had reached the last few pages. When he turned to the next page, the young man couldn't hide the shock on his face, because the remaining pages were all missing corners, torn, or even had chapters torn out.
"Why is this happening? Did something unknown happen later?"
The young man whispered with curiosity, and half of the ancient text in the ancient book appeared in front of him.
"During the prosperous age, all the tribes gathered in Tiandu. In the end, the two camps led by the human race and the demon race faced off. The war broke out again and lasted for thousands of years. The continent of Kyushu was torn apart and Tiandu was shattered. Under the huge force, cracks appeared on the ground of Tiandu. Finally, they grew from small to large and turned into abyss."
"Later generations call it Tianyuan!"
From then on, a taboo existence that resounded throughout the continent and was spoken by various tribes appeared.
